# `schema_of_variant`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns schema in the SQL format of a variant.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
schema_of_variant(v)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `variant_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- schema_of_variant, example 1
> SELECT schema_of_variant(parse_json('null'));
VOID
```

```sql
-- schema_of_variant, example 2
> SELECT schema_of_variant(parse_json('[{"b":true,"a":0}]'));
ARRAY<OBJECT<a: BIGINT, b: BOOLEAN>>
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
